feed.title: S&P Global Ratings warns of risks from China’s generous credit ratings
feed.summary: S&P Global Ratings is warning that China's bond market is accumulating risk due to overly generous credit ratings, particularly as Beijing seeks to attract foreign issuers. Many Chinese bond issuers receive top-tier ratings domestically despite having lower global ratings, potentially masking default risks. This concern comes amidst a push by Chinese authorities to improve rating quality and differentiate credit risk within its growing bond market.

feed.title: Can Oil Momentum Lift Obsidian Energy (TSX:OBE)?
feed.summary: This article examines Obsidian Energy (TSX:OBE), a Western Canadian oil and natural gas producer, and its performance in relation to commodity markets. It highlights the company's focus on production growth, its financial structure, and capital allocation strategy, noting the significant impact of oil and natural gas prices on its results. feed.title: Broadcom Stock Falls Afterhours Despite Strong Earnings Report
feed.summary: Broadcom's shares declined by about 3.4% in after-hours trading despite the company reporting strong third-quarter results. The chipmaker exceeded analyst expectations for revenue, reaching $29.6 billion, an 86% increase year-over-year. However, the results, while positive, did not significantly surpass already high investor expectations, leading to the stock's dip.

feed.title: Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) Tests Its Uptrend As Market Pressure Builds
feed.summary: Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) is facing market pressure despite strong performance in its cloud computing division and AI product deployment. The company is navigating record capital spending, an ongoing competition case, and recent market shifts like rising Treasury yields and crude oil prices. The article delves into the various factors impacting GOOGL's stock, including its legal battles, financial performance, capital expenditure strategy, and the evolving nature of its business from advertising to cloud and AI.

feed.title: Freeport-McMoRan (NYSE:FCX) Scales Fresh Peak As Copper Tests Record Ground
feed.summary: Freeport-McMoRan (NYSE:FCX) stock reached an all-time high as copper prices surged to new records, primarily driven by anticipated American import duties that are causing a rush of metal into domestic warehouses. The company is also managing a staged recovery at its Indonesian Grasberg complex after a mudslide last year, with full production expected later in the decade. These factors, combined with structural changes in copper supply and demand, are creating a favorable pricing environment for the integrated producer.

feed.title: Nucor (NYSE:NUE) Steps Up Mill Spending As Steel Prices Stay Firm
feed.summary: Nucor (NYSE:NUE) is expanding its steel grating production in Indiana, a move driven by record steel mill shipments and firm domestic steel prices. The company's recent quarterly report showed a second consecutive record for steel mill shipments and significantly higher earnings, supported by strong demand from key domestic sectors and revised trade measures that reduced import competition. Nucor's electric arc furnace model and integrated structure, which includes steel products and raw materials segments, help manage market cycles and ensure feedstock supply for higher-specification steels.

feed.title: Deere, CNH stocks surge after Evercore ISI upgrade
feed.summary: Deere & Company and CNH Industrial NV shares rose significantly after Evercore ISI upgraded both agricultural equipment manufacturers to Outperform. Analyst David Raso cited factors such as an aged U.S. high horsepower agricultural fleet, reduced channel inventory, and improving precision agriculture technology for the upgrades, raising price targets for both companies. The firm projects strong earnings per share for Deere and CNH by 2027 and 2028, driven by expected replacement demand and a recovery in the agricultural equipment sector.

feed.title: ISRG Stock: The Best House On The Block Costs The Most
feed.summary: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) is the leading company in robotic-assisted surgery, but despite its operational excellence and strong revenue growth, its stock has underperformed, trailing the S&P 500 significantly. The company commands the highest valuation among its peers due to strong demand for its da Vinci 5 system and international expansion, but faces challenges with moderating U.S. market growth. Investors are watching closely to see if Intuitive Surgical can meet its guided procedure growth range to validate its premium valuation.

feed.title: Kinross Gold (NYSE:KGC) Pushes Ahead on New Builds As Bullion Cools
feed.summary: Kinross Gold is advancing three major construction projects in the US and a fast-tracked development in Ontario, all funded internally from record free cash flow. These projects are designed to sustain output and enhance margins through higher-grade ore, even as gold prices consolidate from recent highs. The company's strategic focus on these long-term projects underscores its confidence in future metal prices and its ability to manage development costs effectively.

feed.title: Goldman Sachs warns investors to expect lower returns over the next year
feed.summary: Goldman Sachs' chief global equity strategist Peter Oppenheimer warns investors to expect lower returns for stocks over the next 12 months, in the mid-to-high single-digit percentage range. This comes after a period of phenomenal returns, with the S&P 500 gaining 12% year-to-date in 2026. Oppenheimer attributes this outlook to factors such as a global government bond sell-off and surging crude oil prices, which are pushing yields higher and pressuring stocks.

feed.title: Chevron CEO Mike Wirth Highlights Two Factors Behind The $7B-Plus Venezuela Bet
feed.summary: Chevron plans to invest over $7 billion in Venezuela in the next five years, aiming to more than double production by 2026 levels. CEO Mike Wirth attributes this decision to improved economic terms, which lower per-barrel costs, and stronger legal protections for investors. The move is supported by both the U.S. and Venezuelan governments and follows a reshaping of Venezuela's oil industry.

feed.title: Comparing Global ETFs: Vanguard's VXUS vs. State Street's Climate-Focused NZAC
feed.summary: This article compares two global ETFs: Vanguard's VXUS and State Street's climate-focused NZAC. VXUS offers broad exposure to non-U.S. markets with a low expense ratio, while NZAC invests in companies aligned with net-zero climate goals, including U.S. stocks. The choice between them depends on an investor's goals, with VXUS providing broader international diversification and NZAC focusing on climate-conscious investments.

feed.title: Expedia (EXPE) Q4 2022 Earnings: Results, Market Reaction & History
feed.summary: Expedia Group reported mixed Q4 2022 earnings, missing Wall Street expectations due to severe weather and increased selling and marketing costs, which impacted EPS and revenue. Despite the miss, the company saw strong growth in lodging and B2B segments, and CEO Peter Kern expressed confidence in future growth and margin expansion due to strong demand and new marketing strategies. The company aims for further growth in 2023 by extending new capabilities and marketing strategies across more brands and geographies.

feed.title: Micron Stock Offers More Than A Market Ride
feed.summary: Micron Technology (MU) stock has shown strong independent growth, outperforming the S&P 500 with an annualized return of 69% over five years due to its unique business model transformation. The company is securing multi-year "take or pay" strategic customer agreements for AI memory chips, aiming to stabilize its notoriously cyclical industry with guaranteed floor prices and robust gross margins. This strategy positions Micron as a differentiated return engine for portfolios, offering growth driven by specific AI demand rather than general market trends, despite increased volatility.

feed.title: Santacruz Silver Mining Ltd. (TSXV:SCZ) Surges 9.91% as Strong Silver Production, Expanding Margins and Precious-Metals Momentum Fuel Buying Interest
feed.summary: Santacruz Silver Mining Ltd. (TSXV:SCZ) saw its shares surge by 9.91% on September 2, 2026, driven by strong second-quarter production across silver, zinc, lead, and copper, particularly due to recovery at its Bolivar mine. This rally reflects renewed investor interest in Santacruz's operational improvements and its exposure to a favorable precious-metals market, despite ongoing risks related to Bolivian logistics and commodity price volatility.

feed.title: KB Home (NYSE:KBH) Stock: Is the Recent Pullback an Opportunity?
feed.summary: KB Home's recent stock pullback raises questions about whether it presents a valuation opportunity or reflects ongoing challenges in the housing market. Despite a lower earnings multiple compared to industry averages, the company's prospects are heavily influenced by housing affordability, mortgage rates, and construction costs. The article explores both the bullish case, supported by a structural housing shortage and favorable regional demand, and the bearish case, highlighting risks from elevated mortgage costs and margin pressures.

feed.title: Citigroup Inc (C) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
feed.summary: Citigroup Inc. reported its Q2 2026 earnings, achieving a net income of $5.8 billion and an EPS of $3.15, marking its best quarterly revenue in a decade with over 9% positive operating leverage. The company saw double-digit revenue growth in four of its five businesses and improved its ROTCE to 13%. Management expressed confidence in hitting its 2026 return target and emphasized a strategic focus on long-term growth and investments, while maintaining flexibility to accelerate structural changes.

feed.title: Thermo Fisher (NYSE:TMO): Is the Rally Running Out of Room?
feed.summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific (NYSE:TMO) has seen a strong rally, bringing its valuation closer to its estimated fair value. While discounted cash flow and earnings models suggest a balanced outlook, future growth will depend on continued business execution, robust life sciences demand, and leveraging emerging areas like AI-assisted protein design. The company's resilience comes from its scale, diversified customer base, and recurring demand for laboratory supplies, but risks include fluctuating life sciences spending and competition.

feed.title: VICI Properties (VICI) Q3 2025 Earnings: Results, Market Reaction & History
feed.summary: VICI Properties reported strong Q3 2025 earnings, beating Wall Street expectations with diluted EPS of $0.71 and total revenues of $1.01 billion, driven by contractual rent escalators and 100% occupancy. The company also announced its eighth consecutive annual dividend increase and raised its full-year 2025 AFFO guidance, reflecting confidence in its long-term lease structure. Key drivers included 4.4% year-over-year revenue growth and 5.3% year-over-year AFFO per share growth, with a weighted average lease term of 40 years across its 93 experiential properties.

feed.title: Chevron CEO Says It's Now Safer to Invest in Venezuela

Wirth's comments suggest an increased confidence in the stability and security of investments in Venezuela.

feed.title: Moderna Stock Moves Lower Wednesday: What's Going On?
feed.summary: Moderna (NASDAQ: MRNA) stock is trading lower on Wednesday after a significant 170% surge in the past month. The decline follows major clinical breakthroughs, including a positive Phase 3 trial for an individualized mRNA cancer therapy and regulatory approvals for its flu and updated COVID-19 vaccines, alongside a $2.6 billion capital raise. However, broader macroeconomic headwinds and elevated Treasury yields are contributing to the selling pressure.

feed.title: DA Davidson reiterates Louisiana-Pacific stock Buy rating at $99
